scope: prove whether forged packets are processed at all, by reading the dedrun's ack fields after sending

verified_facts.server_side_ack_after_forge: client_t samples while forge packets were arriving every 1.0 s: reliableSequence 67 -> 77, reliableAcknowledge 0, messageAcknowledge 0, gamestateMessageNum 4. The body claimed messageAck = 330/376, yet messageAcknowledge stayed 0.
verified_facts.meaning: SV_PacketEvent sets cl->messageAcknowledge from the body; it stayed 0, so the packet never reached that code path

remote_address_of_client.parsed: type=4 (NA_IP), ip=0.0.0.0, port=0x7148 (big-endian 29000), pad=0, then upperqport/other bytes

verified_facts.net_compare_adr: NET_CompareAdr first calls NET_CompareBaseAdr (type+ip) and only then compares ports, so 127.0.0.1 does not match 0.0.0.0 even though the port is 29000
verified_facts.final: before the ip rewrite could be exercised, the dedrun logged Player AdministraClient dropped: EXE_TIMEDOUT and moved the slot to CS_ZOMBIE, so client_t disappeared and the follow-up sample failed

inference_not_verified.statement: the 0.0.0.0 ip is why every forged packet is discarded: SV_PacketEvent's Target2697 branch looks up the client with NET_CompareAdr(from=127.0.0.1:29000, candidate->netchan.remoteAddress=0.0.0.0:29000), fails, sets cl=NULL and answers with an OOB disconnect
inference_not_verified.supporting: messageAcknowledge never changed, and dedrun sends its own packets toward 0.0.0.0:29000 which Windows routes to loopback, so traffic reached the bridge while inbound lookups failed
inference_not_verified.how_to_confirm: rewrite remoteAddress.ip to 127.0.0.1 immediately after the connect handshake (before the dedrun's timeout) and check whether messageAcknowledge starts tracking the forged body

unknown: whether the ip is 0.0.0.0 because Netchan_Setup received a zeroed netadr, or because something clears it later
whether an early rewrite is enough or the dedrun rewrites it again on each packet
next: rewrite remoteAddress.ip to 127.0.0.1 as soon as the client reaches the dedrun (right after connect, before the 20 s timeout), then send forged acks and watch messageAcknowledge/reliableAcknowledge
if the dedrun resets the ip, patch NET_CompareBaseAdr or the lookup branch instead so the comparison ignores ip for loopback
